answer_text: Yes. UMG Article 8 governs the implantation of several constructions on the same plot. The article heading reads IMPLANTATION DES CONSTRUCTIONS LES UNES PAR RAPPORT AUX AUTRES SUR UNE MEME PROPRIETE (c-01)[ARTICLE 8 heading, PDF p.325 / printed p.324]. Section 8.1 allows such construction only if the separating distance is at least 10 m where at least one facing facade has views (c-02)[8.1 text: 10 mètres, si au moins l'une des deux façades ou parties de façades concernées comporte des vues], and at least 6 m where neither facing facade has views (c-03)[8.1 text: 6 mètres, si les deux façades ou parties de façades concernées ne comportent pas de vues]. Section 8.2 exempts only technical equipment, public-service, water, energy-distribution and waste-sorting storage constructions (c-04)[8.2 text: équipements techniques liés à la sécurité, à un service public, à la gestion de l'eau].
additional_context: The 10 m or 6 m distance depends on whether the facing facades have views, which is a building-design fact not determined by this answer. The operative 8.1 text says même terrain while the heading says même propriété; both are read here as the same parcel. Whether the two programme buildings (RSE and Résidence Jeunes Actifs) exist on the parcel is not established by the scoped sources, so their applicability to this programme is not confirmed here.
